cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

pfand_per_offer.description: pfand_per_offer is the PFAND coin required for liquid-mode offers.

valuation_fee_pct.title:
Default auction knobs applied when creating auction NFT classes
 via whaleswap. These mirror nameservice per-class policy knobs.
valuation_fee_pct.description: Default auction knobs applied when creating auction NFT classes via whaleswap. These mirror nameservice per-class policy knobs.  valuation_fee_pct is the percentage applied per valuation_period.

valuation_period.description: valuation_period defines the time duration to which valuation_fee_pct applies.

bid_timeout.description: bid_timeout defines the minimum duration a placed bid must remain pending before it can be claimed by the bidder.

minimum_bid_percent_increase.description: minimum_bid_percent_increase specifies the minimum percent increase required over the current valuation for a new bid to be accepted.

block_delay_before_close.description: ═════ LEVERAGE PARAMETERS ═════ Block delay before position owner can close position

block_delay_before_liquidation.description: Block delay before liquidation can be finalized after initialization
